survivors.what: rules dropped on a supplied repertoire
survivors.note: Non-equivalent, development path: a caller-supplied repertoire with the rules on is built without them while the answer says ACTIVE and the binding records nothing.

survivors.what: N2 lost in the B0-C09 downgrade list
survivors.note: Equivalent under the pinned catalog: the B0-C09 downgrade list is reached only without MACHINES, and then holds no externally loaded accessory pull.
Equivalent under the hash pin: the pinned values bind the catalog in use, and the file-against-expected catalog check stays.
Non-equivalent: NONE athletes with 5+ days (novice keys FULL_B:* differ from regular UPPER_B:*) lose the novice set anchors on a rebuild during the novice weeks.
Non-equivalent: SKIPPED (moved) sessions are counted in planned exposure.
Non-equivalent, development path: a caller rule on authority.repertoire.strength is not stripped (probe A shows the original strips it; no test).

survivors.what: N4 preference kept when own no longer fits
survivors.note: Non-equivalent: once the in-force configuration no longer fits, the mutant keeps preferring the vertical and brings a vertical exercise into a running plan; the declared "nothing is preferred once it no longer fits" is untested.
Non-equivalent: a logged set with reps 0 is counted.
Equivalent for engine-normalized ledgers (at most one live row per session); non-equivalent only for a direct caller passing two live rows.

survivors.what: rules do not reach a supplied authority.repertoire
survivors.note: Non-equivalent, development path: with a caller-supplied authority.repertoire the rules never reach the selection while the answer says ACTIVE.

survivors.what: limitation shown for a plan not under the rule
survivors.note: Non-equivalent: the known limitation is shown on reviews of plans built without, or under other, rules.
Non-equivalent: an error while reading the authority is not contained (probe A: the original contains a throwing records object; no test).
Equivalent: with one slot the only index is 0, which never asks.
Non-equivalent: a record whose independent is missing or any value but false enables its boundary; only independent:false is tested.
Non-equivalent: logged PRACTICE rows are counted as executed working sets (SQ-3 c1).
Non-equivalent: an exercise logged with only rep-less sets lists its muscles with 0 (SQ-3 c4).
Non-equivalent, development path: an inherited strength on a supplied repertoire survives the strip and turns rules on (probe A shows the original strips it).
Non-equivalent: an error inside the exposure would lose the engine answer; containment untested.
Equivalent under the pinned catalog: accessory slots carry no subpatterns, so the both-planes filter already excludes them.
Equivalent under the hash pin: the pinned values bytes carry timeDose null.
Unreachable for engine-built plans (no clash arises, probe B7); non-equivalent only for hand-made programs.

survivors.what: exposure reads the plan before the proposal
survivors.note: Non-equivalent: the exposure describes the plan before the proposal when a review modifies the reviewed week.
